reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001339 (the melody read from 001339a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. William H. Pontius's dates (1857–1937) are from https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2019047885 (Pontius, William H., 1857-1937: born 1857, Circleville, Ohio; singer, voice teacher and composer of songs, piano pieces and church music; died April 1, 1937, Hennepin County, Minnesota; 'Do not confuse with: Pontius, William Henry, 1844-1908', a letter writer); https://shorchor.net/00_people/amer_pontius.html ('William H. Pontius (1857-1937) was born in Circleville, Ohio ... He died in Minneapolis'). https://hymnary.org/person/Pontius_WH, which HOLY HILL (1905) links to, mixes the two (1844-1908 in its name, 1860-1937 in its year fields); either man died before 1955; CCEH's page gives only the year 1905. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001339a.nwc).
